fixtures: interview.mp4 (60 s 960x540: a soft 'head' over a gradient; flite speech, 10 phrases + 3 fillers, pauses up to 3 s)
notes.txt (speaker name and role; 4 topics with their times in interview.mp4)
checks: out/final.mp4: H.264 + AAC, 16:9, at most 51.2 s (dead air removed; an intro of up to 5 s allowed)
all 10 phrases kept, in order (energy envelope cross-correlation)
no silence longer than 0.8 s once the speech starts (-40 dB)
burned captions: text in the bottom third at >= 80 % of the phrase midpoints after 10 s
lower third: left-aligned text in the lower part of the frame within the first 10 s
intro title: text in the upper or middle of the frame within the first 4 s
chapters (out/chapters.txt or chapter metadata): each topic of notes.txt within 2 s of where it starts in the output
[lib] a valid project cuts interview.mp4 (>= 5 clips), with caption cues, a name text clip and a marker per chapter
